resolution: InstantMesh smoke test: ImportError split_torch_state_dict_into_shards from huggingface_hub — latest accelerate needs it but the old hf_hub (pulled by transformers 4.34.1) lacks it (added in hf_hub 0.23). Fix = align to the 2023 stack: pin accelerate==0.24.1 + huggingface_hub==0.19.4 (both compatible with transformers 4.34.1/diffusers 0.20.2). Gave the user the immediate pip command and pinned both in setup-instantmesh.sh. Note: run.py only uses pytorch_lightning.seed_everything, so lightning 2.1.2 + the newer torch 2.6 should be fine for inference despite the era gap. Committed.
